proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived and reviewed the matched joint policy-regret order min{(1+n)^(-1/16),(1+m)^(-3/8)}, its sixth-power gold-sample crossover, a total attaining selector, the uniform compact-edge certificate, and the full shared-prior converse/no-order-fusion comparison. tldr: On the maintained uniform circular causal model with known independent wrapped-Laplace score error, the matched minimax true-score deployment regret is \(M(n,m)\asymp\min\{(1+n)^{-1/16},(1+m)^{-3/8}\}\), uniformly for every public integer \(0\le m\le n\). A total jointly Borel original-record pair policy selects gold at \((1+m)^6\ge1+n\) and noisy records below that boundary; thus the crossover is \(m\asymp n^{1/6}\). The converse uses an analytically certified compact edge frame and causal shared-prior likelihood retaining the \(n^2\), \(nm\), and \(m^2\) terms. It holds against every jointly Borel randomized original-record policy on the same unknown-propensity class. Genuine fusion gives no order improvement over the better channel alone. Possible improvements in optimal constants remain open. The bound motivates prospective QIDS score-validation training and accurately measured deployment; the clinical data are not asserted to instantiate this benchmark.
